record_text:
Key points.
The water cycle as a whole. A continuous loop driven by the sun: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection.

In depth.
Water is never created or destroyed in the cycle, only moved and transformed. Human withdrawals, dams, and climate shifts reroute the loop, which is why watershed-scale management matters.
source_note: Sourced: standard hydrology and water-engineering knowledge.
